statement: The shared benchmark capacity protocol seals per-load sampling windows, accepts finite positive fractional offered loads, accounts every dispatched queue-delay sample, preserves all-error owner evidence, and validates partial and terminal reports fail closed from a clean base.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Every offered-load coordinate has exactly one sealed warmup and measured duration, and every derived expected window and report sequence resolves that coordinate rather than using a global duration.
Positive finite fractional offered loads remain valid, planned-operation and bootstrap bounds remain fail closed, and p99 tail insufficiency remains explicit through the maximum repetition bound.
Queue-delay evidence covers every dispatched operation, all terminal outcomes reconcile exactly, and all-error windows still finalize the owner evidence boundary.
Normal, partial, and resource-completed reports bind exact raw sample digests, sequence coordinates, cache reset receipts, window receipts, and terminal eligibility.
